notes.title: Alpha 18.4.5
Incoming: More immersive world, Adventure Journal and more!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/ccfd6e1b0032b8f7fc68027e3c81da72b5a64e66.png[/img]

[b]Greetings from the Elteria Adventures team![/b]

It’s been an important year for Elteria Adventures so far. The game had switched from semi-realistic to cubic environments with more emphasis on Sandbox gameplay in May, and we’ve collected your feedback through the entire June. After that, we started implementing it into the game in a massive overhaul in order to make Elteria Adventures even better than before, the first results of which you are currently able to see on our alpha servers.

Of course, this is only the beginning — after implementing a completely new worlds system, we are currently working on the main gameplay features that are going to take place in these worlds, which will likely take us the rest of 2021. This work can be separated into four big parts:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/ca6d9c5a445c5e5e8cab16fe73559760ef5c2a88.png[/img]

We are currently working on both improving the visuals of Elteria, and making it more immersive. And in order to do that we are:
[list]
[*] Reworking the way the islands of Elteria are generated and adding details, to make sure they all look diverse, interesting and fun to explore.
[*] Improving the visuals of the nature voxels, with both new pretty textures and reworked old ones.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/db207ca1561d258551d633d59071efd8328b511c.png[/img]
[*] Implementing new and improved behavior for all the in-game mobs to make them more believable.
[*] Redesigning caves and dungeons, so that exploring them is even more fun
[*] Changing  the way music is played, so that it works even better with the gameplay.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/a022c1825870da6fb3bbb9ef22931077fd43b0a8.png[/img]
The fun of exploring the world of Elteria is in a lot of things — new resources, new items, new enemies, new vistas etc. And we thought that it might be a good idea to give one more incentive to venture towards the unknown, which is why we are working on implementing an Adventurer’s Journal.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/821083efe92899357a672c1dc8aa6dfe8b415cc1.png[/img]
Rather than handholding the player, this Journal tells you what might be a good idea to look for and investigate, as well as grants you rewards for completing its entries without forcing you to do anything — like a set of general guidelines (with rewards!).
This feature will take the place of the current Achievement system.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/694dedf0dd6bce25194b15d5597d23e9a73a2654.png[/img]
Having a set of private islands is great. Having a set of private islands that develop as you explore the world is even better.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/16d3720095eab2edd40bac5d9b5e17131c508ee2.png[/img]
Our current goal is to truly make your personal archipelago into your own private base that you’ll be improving by supplying it with resources and materials you find during your trips to more dangerous parts of Elteria.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/348dba98e80309b5cbb732dd3b20470e8e402f84.png[/img]
The co-op gameplay in Elteria has been pretty chaotic so far. Sure, you can form a party and go kill some mobs together, but there are no particular tasks, rules or opportunities for the involved parties besides that.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/b799ec44c394f8d0f9ed840241e20b6f723edec7.png[/img]
Which is why we are working on implementing better social mechanics, including improved party system, trading and even market.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/545561a0beb9e7e7fbc37aa0c04bbe00512c0620.png[/img]
We are also working both on improving several old mechanics, and implementing new stuff:
[list]
[*] [b]Better building[/b]: we’re polishing the building mechanics, so they’re as easy to use and issue-free as possible. We’re also thinking about adding vertical ladders, since stairs are not always an option.
[*] [b]Classy crafting[/b]. Reworking crafting interface to make it less clunky and easier to use. We’re also planning to add more recipe options for similar materials (so, for example, you can use both birchwood and pinewood to make practically the same chair or door)
[*] [b]Better battling[/b]: massive reworks of the battle mechanics, abilities and the likes. Additional movements for the players in-battle (dashing, blocking), and improved look&feel mechanics so that fighting Elterian monsters even FEELS better.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/532b6f3e400e572bb4d8d697a9699a8f607d3bd5.gif[/img]
[*] [b]Fun farming[/b]: yeah, we’re planning to add literal farming, where you plant something (like a carrot), water it, care for it, and then harvest it. We just might add some animal rearing to it to make the experience complete ;)
[*] [b]Supportive sidekick[/b]: you won’t have to travel Elteria all alone! Soon, you’ll have a trusty companion that’ll help you on your journey!
[/list]

We are also working on a rehashed, more streamlined Tutorial, some important changes to the Torches, as well as — and this is VERY important — new and exciting character customization options, so that you’ll have even more stuff to choose from!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/b6764d98c9636dfe93c31c6d3508e2ec90760e8f.png[/img]
Finally, there’s one more thing we’re trying to make our minds about, so we’d like to ask for your opinion:
Do you think that the players’ characters look a tad out-of-place and not-as-charismatic in Elteria now that it’s all cubicky? Because we could give them a makeover so that they look even better. No, we’re not talking about making them all blocky, just a tad more cartoony and bright. Or should they be kept as they currently are (just with more customization options, of course)?

Either way, we hope that you’re as excited for these upcoming changes as we are!

[b]And see you on the islands of Elteria![/b]

notes.title: Megapatch 18.0.1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/f82f84a2183d8bf9c6eb7381168c0d31e2d8d8f4.png[/img]
[b]Greetings from the Elteria Adventures team![/b]

The 18.0.1 Megapatch is finally here! So, without further ado, let’s check what it has for you in store!

[b]GAMEPLAY AND THE WORLD:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]New system of Elteria’s outer worlds:[/b] rather than one big interconnected map, there are many different worlds differentiated by tiers, each with its own lifespan and autoreset timers.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/24917cda2528ea96f5d81a1cd1571d4694f6b386.jpg[/img]
[list][*] [b]New, separate PvP world[/b], for all your PvP needs! You can find it among the Tier 2 worlds![/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/30b0fbceed93ff75bc802d42deb533fb44908760.jpg[/img]
[list][*] [b]Overhauled penalties for death.[/b] Now if you die, you drop a chest containing a random set of items from your inventory (with some exceptions). The chest disappears after 10 minutes, and can be only looted by you in the first 5 minutes, and by any player at all in the remaining 5 minutes.
[*] [b]Major reworks of the crafting system[/b], including reworked recipes, drops, new crafting stages, etc, in order to make crafting more natural and engaging! Moreover, all recipes are now divided between four modes of crafting — with your hands, on a Workbench, on a Construction Workbench and in a Cauldron.
[*] [b]Added craftable Beds[/b] that you can use to skip in-game time in your private world.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/582728c7be5e0249241be96cccc6e1c5daf22e6a.gif[/img]
[*] [b]Bouncy Gel blocks![/b] Added new craftable Gel blocks that you can use as a bouncy trampoline!
[*] [b]Reworked the mob spawner[/b], so the mobs can now spawn depending on the lighting conditions, so you could use light-producing blocks to prevent mobs from spawning in an area. Speaking of which…
[*] [b]Updated the mob roster[/b], featuring new drops, new (or updated) abilities and even new AIs for some of them!
[*] [b]Mobs have returned to the Elterian underground[/b]. You can once again encounter mobs while in the underground caves. Ah, and we improved the way ores and rocks you venture down there for are generated.
[*] [b]Bee’s flight ability reworked[/b]. The flight duration now depends on your Stamina, and once you run out, you slowly glide down rather than falling like a rock. Gaining altitude can be done at any time with the jump button.
[*] [b]Added Carrots![/b] You can now find (and eat) carrots to replenish some of your Health. Though we’re planning to add even more uses for this vegetable![/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/0032d13d65f88fe84f29b154c6ef4670893b6a1e.jpg[/img]
 
[b]VISUALS AND USER INTERFACE:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Reworked the Stamina meter.[/b] It is now displayed to the left of your crosshairs, and disappears if your Stamina is full.
[*] [b]Decluttered your screen[/b] by removing the plaque featuring the name and difficulty of the current Biome and the time of the day. That’s where your lifebar and buff/debuff indicators now are.
[*] [b]Quicker access bar.[/b] Picking up an item will now automatically put it into the quick access bar. If there is no room there, it’ll be put into your Inventory.
[*] [b]Completely reworked the compass[/b], so that you know if your target is directly above/below you
[*][b] Added an info bar about the worlds of Elteria to the map[/b], highlighting their properties and differences. The name and icon of the current world are now displayed in the upper right corner of the screen.
[*] [b]Reworked the way landscapes render[/b], so that the stuff rendering in the distance makes more sense. On that note…
[*] [b]Upgraded the fog effects[/b], so that they look even better on high visual settings!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/acff8b019e9189fe3e08c43878e4230b0540d4b6.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]Reworked the models of items held by the player[/b]. Some were resized, some won’t display at all, everything looks better both while standing still and in motion.
[*] [b]Treasure chests are now more animated, properly sized and fit better into the world.[/b]
[*] [b]Updated animations for bows and consumables[/b]
[*] [b]Added buttons and tips to the sides of the quick access bar[/b]
[/list]

[b]BUILDING:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Major linebuilding rework[/b], so it’s more comfortable and intuitive, with updated visuals and user interface. Currently, it’s the main building mode, and you can switch from linear to diagonal building (like, for building stairs) by holding [Ctrl]. It’s not the final version and we’ve got some additional upcoming adjustments to this system.
[*] [b]Resized the building grid for smaller voxels[/b], so that you won’t see any unexpected air pockets when working with large blocks.
[*] [b]Upgraded the camera in the building mode[/b] to hide the player model if it’s in the way of building. 
[*] [b]Updated building from a cliffside[/b] so that it’s easier to pick a starting point.
[*] [b]The building preview will now disappear if you’re unable to build due to the distance[/b], instead of going in an unexpected direction (usually underground)
[*] [b]Fixed the way building previews look[/b], with differentiating line width for increased depth perception and blue-colored semi-transparent not-yet-installed blocks for increased clarity.
[*] [b]Reworked building voxels[/b] — some are removed, some are updated so that they look better, and added new bricks, tiles and other materials that are available through crafting.
[*] [b]Shape-picking interface is now located at the quick access bar and has a new look[/b]. You can also switch the shape by pressing [TAB] to open the shape-picking menu.
[*] [b]Added object turning in building mode with [Q] and [E] buttons.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/07e67afd1157f19e14e1c3360f32ebc3e94d7596.gif[/img]
[*] [b]Removed the line-deleting mode from the game.[/b][/list]

[b]QUALITY OF LIFE IMPROVEMENTS[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Added a Potion that dispels Polymorph.[/b] Just in case you might need one.
[*] [b]Hometurf Beacon added.[/b] This item will allow you to return to your  Private World’s spawn point.
[*] [b]Reduced mobs’ aggression radius,[/b] so it would’ve been easier for you to avoid unnecessary confrontations.
[*] [b]Less bags, more blocks.[/b] Now instead of spawning bags, the voxels you break will drop appropriately looking cubes.
[*] [b]The object interaction by the [F] button is now more intuitive[/b], and shows text instead of icons.
[*] [b]Reworked the way in-game notifications are displayed.[/b] Now, messages about entering a biome, filling your inventory, not having enough ammo etc will be displayed in the same way in the middle of the screen.
[*] [b]Fixed the tutorial quests for movement and running,[/b] so that completing them takes less time.
[*] [b]Disabled the display of target selectors for most attacks.[/b]
[*] [b]Major rework of the way you interact with objects around you[/b] (blinking, inability to interact with an object etc)
[*] [b]Now you can change your keyboard settings without restarting the game![/b] We’ve also reworked the key localization so that it actually makes sense.
[*] [b]Fixed the mini-freezes upon damaging objects in the world.[/b]
[*] [b]And of course, numerous bugfixes.[/b]
[/list]

As you can see, there’s been quite a lot of changes to the game, though we’re already working on further improvements. Which improvements? We’ll tell you more in our next newspost very, very soon!

[b]And see you on the islands of Elteria![/b]

notes.title: Elterian Co-Op: playing together!
notes.content:
Having your own private archipelago is great! What private archipelago? The one you’re starting your game at! Sure, it takes some time to build a portal to the Main World, but you can always come back to your own safe haven to work on your personal building and crafting projects uninterrupted! And moreover, your private archipelago does not regenerate any changes you have implemented, also allowing you for limitless terramorphing possibilities!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/30f5a1a883b1d7c41c88557db5713ede1faea308.gif[/img]

Ah, but you don’t HAVE to be alone here. You can [b]invite your friends[/b] over to build and terramorph together! Or you can visit their own private archipelagos, or form a party and go to the Main World to challenge its harsher biomes for blocks and materials, that’s also an option!

So, how do you invite someone over?

[b]Inviting someone over:[/b]
Open your Friend List (press V)
Type the name of your friend, send the friendship request.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/18a58dda0f1ba896242e486e65a0cce6650a8756.png[/img]

Once your request is accepted, you can invite them to your private archipelago and allow them to build there (or not)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/c9b680e6f5f808cdead9509b32f2892d8ed340ea.png[/img]

[b]Accepting the invitation:[/b]
Open your Friendlist (press V), accept the friendship request.
Accept the invitation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/102a6bb0d375c4a281b77e3533b288cd1dff1183.png[/img]

Want to have an entire party on your island? You can look for more people (and also follow the game news and events) [url=https://discord.gg/KrxY5RJ]on our Discord server[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/fbe103d3c4b750973183bb7f69489ee8a5a3f0fa.jpg[/img]

And see you on the islands of Elteria!

The long-awaited and (literally) game-changing Open Playtest is finally here, for both new and returning players to enjoy!

Destroy anything in your way, be it the monsters, trees and rocks, or even landscapes until there is absolutely nothing left! Build a house, a massive homebase or an entire island of your dreams using the game’s robust building mechanics! notes.title: Open Playtest early details: the world of Elteria
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/77478045b2e00d18dc4618359434e65ffd405a0f.png[/img]

[b]Greetings from the Elteria Adventures team![/b]
As we work on the upcoming Open Playtest for the new, improved and cubic world of Elteria Adventures, we thought that it might be a good idea to tell you more about what we’re working on. And today, we’ll talk more in-depth about the changes to the world of Elteria itself.

[b]Improved architecture[/b]
With the entire world becoming more blocky, we were able to drastically improve its looks in terms of performance and variety. The simplified shapes allowed us to finally fix the bugs that allowed the camera to look beneath the world’s surface through the unpredictably placed seams in the textures AND to introduce more distinct and varied shapes of natural architecture. The improved and downscaled cubes also mean that you can mimic natural environments with your own tools, and have even more control over what you can build!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/91e7b65b5ac2283dd31f9d0ef32010bca28268c7.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/2393159430c93701e9ae9df5d7300549513d1ea1.png[/img]

[b]Slow Main World regeneration[/b]
Have you ever tried to wipe a small island from the face of Elteria, only to see it slowly begin to regenerate just 10 minutes in? We know we did, and we didn’t like it one bit. Which is why we’ve decided to introduce slower regeneration time to the Main World of Elteria. We’re currently thinking about making that time about two weeks, though we’ll have to see if said time needs any adjustments.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/a4958b0ebe204a8695360dddc4ff454872a10e06.gif[/img]

[b]Private worlds.[/b]
Having a private island is awesome, though it might be a space too limited for all your building and heroic endeavors. Which is why we’re upgrading your private islands to entire private, instance-based archipelagos. Unlike the Main World, your private world will not regenerate at all, allowing for permanent terramorphing! Though that also means that the resources available to you in your Private World are limited, and you’ll have to venture to the Main World for more.
And of course, you won’t be alone on this private archipelago either! You’ll have the company of monsters, as well as any friends you invite over to help you build, gather resources, or just party!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/9bb7698e67828b580d74ca6039b09f24fc20a699.jpg[/img]

[b]Large, interconnected world[/b]
Previously, the biomes of Elteria were too distanced from each other, forcing you to take portals to travel between them. Now, you’ll just need a portal to your private world, and will be able to get anywhere else on foot, clouds or via bridges. Preferably during the day, when you’ll only encounter peaceful mobs. Though if you trust the heart of your gear enough, you can also bravely face the dangers of the Elterian night.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/bc2db9de4a3544718e44e861e295a4499ab25d0f.jpg[/img]

Of course, these are just some of the many changes, improvements and new features of the upcoming Open Playtest. Meanwhile, we’d love to hear from you, be it your questions about these changes to the world of Elteria, requests for new information, or something else entirely

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/deab06b792835c2e4ec5e41acdd022ae081009b4.jpg[/img]

[b]And see you soon![/b]

notes.title: Incoming: New Game World Open Playtest
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/6985f40fcfda87a4eed1487e3d9fa3e9a8fcdc9b.png[/img]
[b]Greetings from the Elteria Adventures team![/b]
The world of Elteria will go cubical even sooner than expected. After seeing the sheer amount of interest in the closed playtest, we have decided that it might be better to go for a key-free open playtest instead. As such, this implies a few things:

[list]
[*] The next Elteria Adventures update [b](ETA end of May, we’ll keep you updated) [/b]will introduce the New Game World, with a reworked gameplay, cubes, mechanics and many, many other new, exciting updates and upgrades!
[*] Since the old characters’ progression is incompatible with this update,[b] everyone will have to start from scratch following a progression reset[/b]. If you want to play through the current questlines, make some screenshots with your friends and challenge all those monsters and bosses as they currently are, you still have some time to do that!
[*] If you have received any awards or promo codes in Elteria Adventures, [b]you should receive them in the new version,[/b] making it even easier to switch to the new Elteria!
[/list]

Lastly, we want to thank both our playtesters and people following our project for the continuous support, though we hope that you’ll enjoy the new and improved Elteria Adventures even more!
[b]See you soon, on the now-cubical islands of Elteria!
[/b]

notes.title: Incoming: New Game World
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/2480c3841307c281c9b169ba1252231626295f24.png[/img]

[b]Greetings from the Elteria Adventures team![/b]
It’s been quite a while since the last piece of news from our project, hasn’t it? Well, today we’ve got something very exciting to show you as the result of months of research, development and playtesting (HUGE thanks to our alpha testers, by the way!), that we hope, will help us to create a much more focused, fun and creative experience for you to enjoy. Introducing the brand new game world!

[b]Cubes![/b] This part can be recognized instantly. The world, previously consisting of rounded cubic voxels, has now become almost entirely cubified. We know, we loved the smooth realistic terrains too! But not only did the playtests show us that these new cubic surroundings looked way more in line with your own beautiful architectural creations, they also made the environments much more easily readable and even prettier to look at. Just look at these screenshots!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/bf73a49ed550afcffe2fd06ccf872a5c099f8989.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/bbf4317cf1e1fea08ab06f8f2416276a28308040.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/672c569101e6cd8de11c1a1d260ea8e28ae08e49.jpg[/img]

[b]Optimized Building.[/b] Smaller cubic voxels also allow us to introduce a number of new possible buildings and add more variation in natural geometries such as caves and mountains. The upgraded building mechanics are also more comfortable to use, making it so much easier to create the home base of your dreams or even an entire fortified sky island that would look completely at place among its surroundings! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/3243af19b6d528eaf0120fd0ecbcd84313c2b4ad.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/f3ffff7a610933fed3717922549be062be2f197d.jpg[/img]

[b]Accessible Terramorphing.[/b] We’ve made it easier to both gather resources, as well as destroy and rebuild your environments. Don’t care for gathering extra rock and dirt? Put aside your Glove and just crush these blocks into nothing with your trusty weapons! All said destruction of your surroundings will linger for far, far longer, making it possible to even use terramorphing for base building! Incorporate your base into a mountain! Make a basement! Erase an island you don’t like and make it STAY that way!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/087e44175dfdaa81d78fb9a9ea1dd9c6d7b4c5b9.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/533ff21e4e699e4f601d78b5a5c89df638b81374.jpg[/img]

[b]Sandboxy goodness.[/b] More narrative freedom to go with your mechanical freedom! Go wherever you want and do whatever you want from the start. No more essential progression hidden behind quests! In fact, we are currently reworking the quests to be far more open and fun, and far less resembling running through your grocery list.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/4e7626429075f328ecfca8ba2f11ff6942b458b5.jpg[/img]

[b]Explore and survive in the world of Elteria along with your friends![/b] And of course, you can still gather your team and restore the world of Elteria together with!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/32d86f919a5874b8e3093792c401275a5c492eb2.jpg[/img]

We want to thank all our alpha testers for their feedback and for their help in making our dream game come true

[b]If you’d like to be among the first playtesters of the closed new version, just comment here and we’ll send you an invite![/b]

notes.title: Happy New Year!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/a4edc53a446c65acf9a87e6396e9507fb4838e8c.png[/img]
[b]Happy New Year, festive adventurers![/b]

You know, Elteria Adventures went through a lot of changes in 2020. Ranging from purely cosmetic to mechanical, up to and including the game’s story, these changes were all made in order to make the game as fun and enjoyable as possible. And of course, the Elteria Adventures team plans to continue this tendency in 2021, in order to bring you even better experiences on the floating islands of Elteria.

In fact, we’re already working on something huge in order to bring Elteria Adventures even closer to our vision, and hope to bring you the first look into it very, very soon.

We’re extremely thankful to all of you for helping us turn our dreams into reality, and hope that you will continue to  support us in the following year and onwards!

[b]Once again, Happy New Year to you, and be sure to have fun and happy Holidays![/b]

notes.title: Patch 17.1

notes.title: Elteria Adventures: Item Enchanting Guide
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/b41a741edcc0cc0f2a6f29053357473fbc2fb5cd.png[/img]
While maxing out your gear in Elteria Adventures is not necessary, it might give you a much needed edge in a fight, or push your damage just enough to one-shot a mob you’re currently farming. There are currently four mechanics that allow you to do just that.

[b]1. ITEM RARITY (Workbench/Advanced Workbench).[/b]
Whenever you craft a piece of equipment, you have a small chance of crafting one of an increased Item Rarity. Signified by a corresponding adjective and a colored border around its icon, such an item boasts higher stats than a regular version.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/eafd17486bf7b207b78777370a051782058c18f7.png[/img]
Of course, the process of deliberately crafting a rare item might leave you with a lot of spares. These might be Dismantled on a Soul Altar to gain some extra Essentia, though you might also want to keep some spares due to the next step.

[b]2. AWAKENED, TRUE AND ASCENDED (Workbench/Advanced Workbench).[/b]
Crafting a piece of equipment is just the beginning. Once you have crafted a weapon, an armor or an accessory, you can also use it to craft an upgraded version with significantly boosted stats, with Awakened and True versions available to most gear, and exceptionally powerful Ascended versions for some cases. Crafting any of these upgraded versions will require you some extra legwork though, with increasingly more valuable and difficult to obtain resources from later chapters or Wild Area.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/5a653372c049e389babc8b148c2caa3fdd67b2e2.png[/img]
Do note that using a piece of gear in crafting basıcally scraps ıt to gıve you a new one (rolling for Item Rarity again), which is why you might need those extra crafted pieces of regular Item Rarity.

[b]3. REFORGING (Anvil).[/b]
Once you have finally got that incredibly lucky Wild True Carrot Sword, it’s due time to fine-tune it to suit your personal playstyle. For the first part you can use an Anvil to Reforge it, giving you a set of random bonuses
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/f64f61a325d5d966c259001f5bebc338e3197969.png[/img]
This process can be repeated for as long as you have the necessary materials.

[b]4. SOUL FUSION (Soul Fusion Altar).[/b]
Farming for Souls doesn’t just allow you to use their signature abilities, you can also use these Souls to fortify your gear even further. The Soul Fusion Altar allows you to put up to three different souls into an item, boosting a specific stat for each.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/3bdd8bf9ae214f3ae738c6b65b22d0cd4cbe54b9.png[/img]
Of course, the Souls of stronger mobs give you even higher bonuses

All of these effects are stackable and applicable to all item slots (Weapon, Armor, Necklace, two Rings, two Earrings, Hat, Boots), so there is a lot of room to make your adventuring easier even if you decide not to bother with some of them.

And regardless of whenever you’re maxing out your gear all the way, use some of these mechanics or decide to use unmodified gear, be sure to join [url=https://discord.com/invite/KrxY5RJ]our Discord server[/url] where you can share this and other info with other players, talk to the dev team and participate in our contests.

[b]See you on the isles![/b]

notes.title: Prepare for the upcoming Jumping Contest!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/854339257c5b779fff1aca11a5922443d8cd1b3c.png[/img]
[b]Salutations, skilled skyhoppers![/b]
Are you prepared for the [b]Head-Jumping contest[/b] during End of Summer party on September 12th and 13th? We bet you could be a little bit more prepared, especially if you’re aiming for the top spots in that contest. And you really need some info to be as prepared as possible, which is why today we’re going to look at two things: the general rules of the contest, and the build that would allow you to be the hoppiest, jumpiest adventurer around.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/1a609644111c00874526da465c196077efa385f4.gif[/img]

First of all, for the [b]general principles of the contest:[/b]
[list][*]The contest will follow a general timed Deathmatch format (but instead of death, someone jumps on your head).
[*] Each adventurer acts on their own and has to jump on the heads of other adventurers as many times as possible.
[*] Naturally, we’ll limit the effectiveness of consecutively using the same head as your jumping board, so you’ll have to switch between targets to maximize your score.
[*] The contest will utilize a ranking board where you’ll see both top players and your own score so you know what to aim for
[*] There are two types of prizes: a prize for performing a certain amount of jumps in the contest, and a prize for reaching one of the top spots in the contest.
[*] The info about the prizes will be available later on, though be warned: they’re cosmetic, they’re unique and they look fantastic.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/dccb646a9d3a237e3d0c682ad5eeb3f15ea0e2b0.gif[/img]

[b]Now, within these rules, how can you maximize your potential?[/b]
[b]Extra jumps:[/b] if you can perform midair jump more times than your opponent, you’ll have an easier time landing on their head. Boots help with that, though you might want to obtain Sally’s Wonderful Shoes that give you TWO extra jumps instead of one. A Sturdy Leather Armor and Extra Jump Potion also give you an extra jump and are also relatively  easy to obtain, and if you’re able to obtain a Carrot Sword, that’s another extra jump. By combining all of these items, you can obtain FIVE midair jumps.
[b]Flying:[/b] There is currently no True Flight in Elteria Adventures, though the Bees’ flight comes pretty close, and is obtainable through Turn into Bee Potion or bee souls. Sure, the speed of their flight is nothing to write home about, but that extra mobility might help you in a pinch.
[b]Movement abilities:[/b] the Warrior calling has two movement abilities that allow you to either dash, or instantly jump dozens of feet into the air.
[b]Battlefield Control:[/b] There are several abilities that allow you to either impede other players or boost yourself. Architect’s constructs, and Summoner’s bump mushroom and sunflower can easily shape the battlefield
[b]Personal Pushback:[/b] Slime souls can give you the ability to push back other players. Oh, and in case you want to resist the pushback of other players, you might want to raise your Tenacity with items like Potion of Tenacity.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/c40b9cc0fd32c2e9afeeee7eb4d934b76b3e3d23.png[/img]

Of course, these are not the only ways you can raise your chances in the upcoming contest, and we’re excited to see what else our players will bring to the table.


And before that, be sure to join[url=https://discord.gg/KrxY5RJ] Elteria Adventures’ Discord server[/url] where you can follow and discuss news of upcoming features and events, talk and coordinate with other players, and even communicate directly with the developer team.
See you soon!

notes.title: Incoming feature: Scythes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/a5a9c2ce43357dd5802ed77f31cebb86864011a5.png[/img]
Greetings from the [b]Elteria Adventures[/b] team!

Can you hear the eerie sound of cold, sharp metal slicing through the [b]Elterian[/b] air and training dummies alike? That sound can be heard from the [i]Agelon Research Center[/i], which was tasked with uncovering and testing the weapon designs long lost to time. And the ARC just agreed to let us have a peek on a new type of weapon, both powerful, intimidating and soon to be available in [b]Elteria[/b]. We’re talking about [i]Scythes[/i]:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/6226b39acefac7e5702c65a4bf6d6ca14a21fd48.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/50036dcd8045a5144be4806ffc4bba3f295f47dd.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/74ec14246bfefe784bad3ee63e0279ee066fbc21.png[/img]

As you can see, this weapon is much unlike the [i]Swords, Cores and Gauntlets[/i] common to the islands of [b]Elteria[/b]. According to ancient texts, this type of weaponry is a kind of a polearm — a mid-ranged melee weapon that allows one to keep their opponent relatively at bay while dishing out significant damage. Of course, [i]ARC[/i] is also already looking into effective ways of handling such weapons:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/0d9193cc18dc37559925da7dd85bd407d72af4c9.gif[/img]

notes.title: Incoming: The Slime Sumo.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/26c315a866da546279aadb1d849bf860feb6594e.png[/img]

[b]Greetings from the Elteria Adventures team![/b]

If you ever wanted to measure your ability against your fellow player, there are ways to do so in [b]Elteria[/b]. You can clash in the [i]Arena[/i] or in the Wild Area to see who among you is the strongest. You can also brave the obstacle course in a race against each other to see who reaches the finish first. Alternatively, you can just have a peaceful building competition - and soon, you’ll also be able to compete in being the best Pink Slime. Introducing: the Slime Sumo.

[i]Slime Sumo[/i] is an incoming [b]PvP[/b] game mode in which every participant is transformed into a round and bouncy Pink Slime, armed just with the abilities to move and knock back creatures it bumps into. The goal of a [i]Slime Sumo[/i] match is simple - to use said abilities to eliminate every other participant by knocking them off the island the match is held on. And at the end, the one sole winner of this brutal clash of pink jelly against pink jelly, of course, will receive a handsome reward, be it a [i]Ruby[/i] or a [i]Crystal[/i] used in reforging.

Of course, these [i]Pink Slimes[/i] lack any damaging attacks and abilities and can only eliminate their targets by knocking them off the island, which means that this game mode relies almost exclusively on the player’s skill and timing with no regard to their Calling, level or equipment. Or, in other words, the Slime Sumo is meant to be the way for players of different levels to compete on the same playing field.

We hope that once the [i]Slime Sumo[/i] reaches the alpha servers, you’ll help us in improving it with your feedback and criticism. The best way to do so is by telling us directly on our [url=discord.gg/F4khSmK][u][b]Discord server[/b][/u][/url] - where you can also stay notified about any and all updates to the game (including this very [i]Slime Sumo[/i] game mode). 

[b]See you on the islands of Elteria - and see you next time![/b]

notes.title: Alpha 16.3.0
notes.content:

[b]Greetings from the Elteria Adventures team![/b]

In this patch, we’ve prepared a nice pack of nice hotfixes and improvements to improve your [b]Elteria Adventures[/b] experience, and get rid of several small annoyances in the process.

[h3]OPTIMIZATION:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]The world spins faster[/b]. We’ve optimized the way voxels are destroyed, which will be especially noticeable in how much smoother the Pumpking and Blue Shark fights are. 
[*] [b]Taking hits on the fly[/b]. Optimized the way damage is displayed when a lot of damage is dealt (for example, when a shark burrows and receives damage from destroyed voxels).
[*] [b]Now you see them, now you fight them[/b]. Optimized the way mob models are loaded.
[/list]
[h3]OTHER CHANGES:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]This is not what they mean by “safety deposit”[/b]. Private zones no longer save ore deposits. 
[*] [b]Appropriately fluffy[/b]. Fixed interactions with clouds (this time for sure).
[*] [b]Seeing where you’re stepping[/b]. Finally fixed a rare bug that caused huge chunks of the world to randomly decide not to render.
[*] [b]PvP-viable summons[/b]. Summoner’s abilities now correctly attack other players in PvP, and are invulnerable to party members and the summoners themselves. 
[*] [b]Statue-moving service[/b]. Statues can now be Gathered with a glove.
[*] [b]“Rad Redd”, read in red[/b]. If your character name is colored via potion, it is now displayed in the character interface.
[*] [b]20 letters is enough[/b]. A nickname is now correctly limited by 20 characters.
[*] [b]Precious notifications[/b]. The game will now notify you about getting new items whenever you get a ruby or a crystal. 
[*] [b]Press [F] to open the door, just not too much[/b]. The item interaction with the [F] button (like with doors) can’t be spammed anymore since it led to lags.
[*] [b]Way ahead of you[/b]. Quests for crafting an item will now be completed if the player already has said item (or its next version in case of Universal Glove).
[*] [b]What do you mean these are not equal?![/b] Iron sword and magic staff now have different stats.
[/list]

We hope that these changes will make [b]Elteria Adventures[/b] even more fun and enjoyable for you! The [b][i]Steam Game Festival[/i][/b] has just concluded, and yet we’re already back with another patch. This time it’s about a pack of small, quality-of-life features, and a lot of fixes:

[list]
[*] [b]Wild boss fights[/b]. Added a simple quest line for killing bosses in the Wild Area.
[*] [b]It’s good to have a spare[/b]. You can now craft a 1st level Universal Tool glove on a workbench.
[*] [b]Arrows for all directions[/b]. The Compass now shows all active navigation icons, including those that point backwards (at the edges of the Compass).
[*] [b]Cutting to the chase[/b]. If an NPC has a quest for you, they’ll start the dialogue with said quest.
[*] [b]Fluffier clouds for everyone![/b] Increased the hitboxes of clouds a bit so it’ll be easier not to miss one while cloudjumping.
[*] [b]Not lost in the translation[/b]. Added some of the missing English translations.

[h3]FIXES:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]There is no escape[/b]. You can’t close the loading screen with the [ESC] button anymore.
[*] [b]Going through the list[/b]. Updated the list of items you can craft on a workbench, fixed the filters in the reforge and on the soul altar.
[*] [b]Pretty on the outside, pretty on the character screen[/b]. Your nickname on the Character screen will now be colored if you’ve used a potion to do so.
[*] [b]Undamaged goods[/b]. The glove can’t destroy resources that can’t be damaged anymore.

[*] [b]Getting over a crash[/b]. Fixed a few issues that caused crashes during the game launch and/or at random times.

[*] [b]One revival is enough[/b]. Death screen won’t require you to revive twice anymore.
[*] [b]By the power of a bunny, I have power![/b] Simplified the Hare Statue’s buff. It won’t give you essences anymore, and you can replenish its damage boost as often as you want to. It might still disappear, this will be fixed in the following patches as the problem is identified by now.
[*] [b]Relogins do nothing[/b]. Fixed the bug that caused relogins to reset ability cooldowns.
[/list]

We hope these updates will make [b]Elteria Adventures[/b] even more fun for you! [b]Greetings from the Elteria Adventures team![/b] 

We just had a huge 16.0 megapatch last week, introducing a ton of new and amazing stuff ([i]including [/i][i]Wild Area, Item Rarity System and the new Private Zones[/i]), and now we’re kicking off the [b][i]Steam Game Festival[/i][/b] with yet another update full of goodies for everyone to enjoy.

[list]
[*] [u]Anastasia’s Neighbour[/u]. Added dialogues for dark Elteria Hearts (the ones that appear in the Wild Area).
[*] [u]A fine addition to my soul collection[/u]. Added a new questline about collecting souls in the Wild Area.
[*] [u]Statuesque carrot munchers[/u]. Added Hare Statues that you can place in your Private Zone. You can get it from Hares by trading it for a Shark Statue.
[*] [u]Furniture? Funniture![/u] Added new windows and doors, as well as paintings, wardrobes and crates (for now, these are all decorative items).
[/list]

[list]
[*] [u]Essentially not the same[/u]. When you break items of different quality at the Soul Altar, they’re shown separately.

[*] [u]Enough practice dummies for everyone[/u]. The starting quest to destroy practice dummies requires less targets destroyed. Also, there are overall more practice dummies now.

[*] [u]Precious AND gatherable[/u]. Dark, Nature and Link gems can now be gathered.

[h3]BUGFIXES:[/h3]
[list]

[*] [u]Bug sprayed the magical termites[/u]. Fixed the bug during the reforge of similar items (one of which was equipped), that caused the equipped item to disappear after the reforge.
[*] [u]Summoners do NOT demolish![/u] Fixed the Demolisher’s pumpkee-killing quest accepting pumpkee kills using other callings.
[*] [u]Changing back in three, two, one…[/u] Fixed the bug that caused a player to be stuck in a polymorphed form, requiring them to re-enter the server.

[*] [u]It’s an obstacle course, not a farm![/u] Fixed (again) unnecessary item drops on the obstacle course and the arena.
[*] [u]Penguin-friendly architecture[/u]. Fixed the launcher’s performance issues for Ubuntu. It now also shows the server status correctly.
[*] And many other small tweaks and fixes

We hope these updates and our participation in the [i][b]Steam Game Festival[/b][/i] will make [i][b]Elteria Adventures[/b][/i] even more fun for you! notes.title: Alpha 16
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/324c3a76a8903aaca4daf68d5c07e47400a6e71e.png[/img]


[b]Greetings from the Elteria Adventures team![/b]

Today, we’ve got a huge Mega Update to share with you. And we do mean huge, so without further ado:

[list]
[*] [u][b]Going Wild.[/b][/u] [i]Added the Wild Area[/i] - a huge archipelago with a free progression, a lot of different mobs and bosses, and an Always On PvP. It’s accessible starting 3rd Calling level through a portal near the castle. Before that, you can always just check it in the right corner of your World Map (just press [M]).
[*] [u][b]Beet me up, Scotty![/b][/u] [i]Added the teleportation network[/i]. Just talk to a new Qubeet NPC, and it’ll be able to teleport you to the location of any other Qubeet in Elteria for a small price of a handful of gem shards. 
[*] [u][b]Home Sweet Home.[/b][/u] [i]New and improved Private Zones[/i] - this time as another ginormous archipelago consisting of small islands, each island belongs to one player. You can access it after completing just a few starter quests and obtaining a key for your own Private Zone. You can also check the archipelago on your World Map (still opened by pressing [M]).
[*] [u][b]Home Sweet Home MKII:[/b][/u] Wild Edition. [i]You can place a second Private Zone in the Wild Area using a 3rd level glove.[/i] Who said you can’t have a second home base?
[*] [u][b]All the levels, all of them![/b][/u] Each Calling now has 99 levels to obtain in your adventures. But don’t worry, the levelup cost stops rising past 21st level, so paired with the Comfort system that boosts the Essence gain, the further you go, the easier it’ll be for you to level up!
[*] [u][b]Not gathering dust.[/b][/u] [i]The Universal Tool (also known as Neophyte’s Glove) can now be upgraded up to 10th level.[/i] So much easier than blowing up the ore deposits!
[*] [u][b]What’cha buying?[/b][/u] [i]Some NPCs are now trading far better items than before.[/i] From workbenches and Private Zone decorations to recipes for powerful items and hard to find monster souls.
[*] [u][b]So many new items.[/b][/u] [i]28 new items.[/i] 38 new items if we count all new variations. And we’re talking weapons, armors, crowns etc.
[*] Decluttering the inventory. You can now break items down at the Soul Altar. Doing so grants you Soul Essences which can be used to level up.
[*] [u][b]Do you want to talk about it?[/b] [/u][i]Added quite a few new dialogues.[/i] Including, but not limited to, reworks of several starting quests. Also, you’ll notice a few new NPCs, especially around the castle.
[*] Sweet freedom![i] There’s now an “Unstuck” button in the menu[/i]. Just in case something doesn’t work as it should.
[*] [u][b]But that’s not all![/b][/u] Updated the item drop rates, added sound effects, titles and tasks of quests in English and Russian, as well as Russian descriptions in the journal.
[/list]

[h3]INTERFACE:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [u][b]Sweet, sweet clarity.[/b][/u] New interface with quest tasks and pinned recipes in the right corner of the screen.
[*] [u][b]Easier built than said.[/b][/u] New building interface utilizing F1-F5 keys.
[*] [u][b]I can see everything I’ve equipped![/b][/u] New inventory interface with equipment slots, item names and descriptions. As usual, just press [C] to access it.
[*] [u][b]“Home” is where you need to teleport to.[/b][/u] If you use the “Teleport Home” ability, you can now choose between the Castle of Agelon, your Private Zone and your latest Elteria Heart.
[*] [u][b]A hearty conversation.[/b][/u] Speaking of which, the Elteria Heart interaction is now in the form of dialogue.
[*] [u][b]Oooh, pretty.[/b][/u] Updated the icons for many abilities, items and achievements.
[*] [u][b]Expanded geography.[/b][/u] Updated the map and made it easier to navigate between biomes.
[*] [u][b]I’d rather not see either, but it’s still nice.[/b][/u] New and improved death screen and disconnect screen.
[*] [u][b]Now that’s beautiful.[/b][/u] New launcher and splash arts for the loading screen!
[/list]

[h3]MECHANICS[/h3]
[list]
[*] [u][b]Chasing clouds away.[/b][/u] The clouds won’t spawn in certain areas anymore (like in Private Zones and on the obstacle course).
[*] [u][b]I’m already poisoned, thank you very much.[/b][/u] The Poisonous Mushroom debuff no longer stacks for players. 
[*] [u][b]Fearless wiggling.[/b][/u] Tentacle Polymorph is now a bit beefier and grants you a fear immunity.
[*] [u][b]Window shopping.[/b][/u] Workbenches now show every possible recipe. Yeah, including those you can’t craft yet. 
[*] [u][b]Workbenches for everyone![/b][/u] Crafting stations can be crafted, received as a quest reward, or bought from certain NPCs. Also, now there’s a golden anvil in the game. For now, it’s just decorative.
[*] [u][b]Peace and tranquility. [/b][/u]Mobs and clouds spawn can now be turned off in some areas.
[*] [u][b]Show me the way.[/b][/u] Updated how the compass markers work. The death marker is now always shown on the compass.
[*] [u][b]What do you mean I can’t open these?[/b][/u] Fixed the interaction with objects that can’t really be interacted with (the chests on the obstacle course).
[*] [u][b]One key is all I need.[/b][/u] The key for the Architect’s Calling quest will now only spawn once, and only if you’re currently playing through this quest.
[*] [u][b]Still working on the Trickster.[/b][/u] We’ve added a new ability called “Deja Vu” for this Calling, though it’ll be some time before it’ll be released and available.
[/list]

[h3]BUGFIXES[/h3]
[list]
[*] Rendering due to digging or breaking items won’t be as noticeable as before, It also won’t cause grass to change its position now.
[*] Architect’s platform can’t push objects that’ll keep hanging in the air after the platform disappears.
[*] Fixed the line break in the journal in tasks and descriptions.
[*] Fixed the bug that caused Bounce Jump to bounce the player without lowering the Spirit of the target.
[*] Fixed the client crash due to the player polymorphing into an exploding pumpkin.
[*] Fixed some client crashes due to running the game on Linux and integrated videocards.
[*] Server disconnect doesn’t cause a client crash and allows reconnection.
[*] Fixed the memory leak after server reconnection.
[*] Fixed the client crash due to the start of the Arena event. 
[*] Lighting on the character models in GUI doesn’t change with the time of the day anymore.
[*] Reworked the death screen so it appears consistently.
[*] Fixed the building block preview during building. Said preview now also always corresponds with what will be placed.
[*] Fixed the looping of the sound of falling in case of death due to falling off an island.
[*] Fixed the incorrect nickname color display in the local chat immediately after drinking the nickname color potion.

In order to participate in this quest beta, you need to fulfill three conditions:[list][*] [b]Reach the 3rd character level.[/b] You can easily do so by completing a few quests, for example, the main quest line.

Once you accept his quest, you’ll have some time to enter the arena, equip your best gear and souls and drink all the useful potions you’ve got, before the waves start.
The Arena Invasion consists of five waves. Each wave constantly spawns several types of mobs, only one of which is vulnerable. You have two tasks during each wave:[list][*] [b]Survive the Invasion wave until the timer runs out[/b] (bring your healing items!)
[*] [b]Collect enough parts of the vulnerable mobs of each wave[/b] ([i]Little Boarmelons, Skeletons, Garnet Armadillos, Purple Tentacles and then Lemon Bees[/i]. You’ve upgraded your weapons, right?). 
[/list]

Despite what some of the locals and even veteran heroes might’ve told you, there IS something beneath the flying islands of the [i]Kingdom of Agelon[/i], and it’s easy to get there too - just dive off one of the islands, and you’re almost certain to arrive at  that place safely. [i]Wild Area[/i] is, essentially, a layer of islands that is located beneath the surface of the islands of the [i]Kingdom[/i], or the ones neighbouring it. And this place is home to a wide range of exciting things to experience:[list]

notes.title: Incoming: Crafting changes and Teleports!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/33c9ad45c76b05bc6be87b3474225f9be0748d89.png[/img]

[b]Greetings from the Elteria Adventures team![/b]

Our last update was all about important bug fixes, as well as [i]Quality of Life[/i] changes. Naturally, we’re working on even more ways to make [b]Elteria Adventures[/b] a welcoming and fun world to be in, which is why a number of other exciting Quality of Life changes are already on their way. Today, we’ll tell you about some of them:
The first on today’s list is the [b]Crafting[/b], the changes to which are twofold: introduction of Item [i]Dismantling, improvements to Item Crafting,[/i][list][*][u][b]Break down an item to get resources.[/b][/u] That’s right, you won’t have to tolerate duplicates or items you’re no longer using cluttering up your precious inventory screen. Just put a special workbench in your Home Base, and break down anything you don’t need. Free up that space and get some resources, to either craft something new and exciting, or remake that same item. “Why would I want to do that last one”? Well, that’s because…[*][u][b]A chance to craft an item of improved quality.[/b][/u] What could be better than a Watermelon Staff? A Legendary Watermelon Staff, of course! The updated crafting system will introduce a chance to craft an item of improved quality. There are five overall quality types: Common, Perfect, Legendary, Wild, and Mythic, so whenever you want a collection of different grades of your favorite weapon or armor, or you just want to have an item with the perfect stats, you’ll be able to craft it yourself.
[/list]
Meanwhile, the convenience of  public transportation is finally about to reach the kingdom of [i]Agelon[/i]. Not buses or monorail, of course - it’d be quite hard and costly to build a railway system between the sky islands of [b]Elteria[/b]. We’re talking about something much cheaper and simpler - teleportation!
[list][*] [b][u]Beam me up, Qubit![/u] [/b]The special NPCs called Qubits are going to appear in different parts of Elteria, allowing for an instant transit between themselves. Thanks to this, your daily commute between different parts of Agelon will become much faster and easier - and to think it only took some mild breaks of space-time continuum to achieve!
[/list]
So collect all the necessary crafting components, and get ready to zap around [b]Elteria[/b] brandishing your epic loot at the speed of light once these updates reach the alpha servers!. And if you want to be instantly notified of such an update and any other[b] Elteria Adventures[/b] news, as well as discuss the game with other players and us, you can do so on our [url=https://discord.gg/hSVgG8B][b]Discord server[/b][/url].

Exploring new, unfamiliar lands in search of adventures, treasures and glory is fun - but sometimes those very things could well be found in a place you’ve been to before.

Our latest update had introduced one such adventure: an opportunity to face the powerful, dangerous and regal [i]Highboars[/i] on the outskirts of [i]Faldaren isles[/i]. The veterans of the Royal Hunt will be able to join this effort as soon as this quest drops on the alpha servers.

Additionally, there were sightings of different unusually behaving creatures and entities both in [i]Orzan[/i], [i]Faldaren[/i] and even near the [i]Castle of Agelon[/i] itself. These creatures - a [i]Lonely Boar[/i], a [i]Lonely Bee[/i], a [i]Lost Red Slime[/i], a [i]Secret Tentacle[/i] and a [i]Statue of a Hare[/i] - are hidden in different parts of [b]Elteria[/b]. In the case of these critters, just talking to them is more than enough - though finding them is not going to be that easy.

You can already start the [i]Highboar[/i] quest line by talking to [i]Yan[/i] in [i]Faldaren[/i] after finishing [b]Chapter I[/b]. notes.title: Legendary Fight
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/b70e8a3cf4ce5c2df97ae73852f9ea08833595fe.png[/img]

If you want to discuss the story, head over to our [b][url=https://discord.gg/u2AVU5K]Discord[/url][/b] server!

The sharp teeth violently gnashed against metal, breaking the blade apart like an old, brittle twig. The second monstrous bite would’ve easily taken the rest of the weapon, along with the arm holding it, yet the beast stumbled and pulled back with an angry, pained growl as its back was pierced by a dozen of thin, sharp, long, icy needles, each the length of a pike, accompanied by a cold, freezing ringing through the air. All barely missed anything vital, on account of slightly shaky aim. Didn’t do a lot of damage, but it sure as hell was painful.

[i]Htorh[/i] shortly glared to the side, giving the woman that got the enemy off his back for these brief few moments an affirming nod. More attention than he’d usually give an ally even after the fight. [i]Orho[/i] understood. They’re both from the [i]Hare tribe[/i], after all.

The furious roar of the current champion of the Arena couldn’t be drowned even by the deafening, cacophonous howling of the spectators. The Champion of this Arena, an enormous blue shark, was big and hungry enough to devour both [i]Htorh[/i] and [i]Orho[/i], and then gobble a few human adventurers for the sweet. Its strength well matched its appetite, and so did its stamina - the two hares were fighting it for a good hour by now. All three participants were bloodied.

[i]Htorh[/i] threw away the now useless crumbled blade, and unsheathed the last weapon he had packed for the fight. The carrot sword this time. Magical thing, a pride for any warrior in the [i]Hare tribe[/i] and a declaration that he was going for the kill. [i]Orho[/i] slightly nodded, and then downed a piece of fruit to replenish her stamina, if only for a bit. Just one, despite her visible exhaustion. Must be the last one she’s got. 

The champion snarled and then dived into the sand, completely disappearing underground. Not good. Last time it did that, it outright shredded [i]Orho’s[/i] good arm. The time before that, it broke about half of [i]Htorh’s[/i] ribs.

Blue shark’s next target… He was sure it was [i]Orho[/i].

The hare warrior kicked the ground, shortening the distance to his ally. She understood, and readied her next attacking spell under her breath, simultaneously preparing to dodge the incoming attack.

Then, a sudden burst of overwhelming pain. The ground and the sky swirled together in a violent motion, and as he lost any feeling save for pain in his legs, [i]Htorh[/i] could’ve sworn that one of them landed in the neighbouring pile of sand.

He miscalculated.

As the Indomitable warrior [i]Htorh[/i] was losing his consciousness, he saw [i]Orho[/i] sending another barrage into the shark. The thing managed to shrug it off. Of course it did.

notes.title: Incoming: Experience System
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/707769db0bc786043e55157fc88357adb2a6f9bc.png[/img]

[b]Greetings from the Elteria Adventures team![/b]

It is no secret that at this point the game doesn’t have such thing as [b]Character Levels[/b]. There are multitudes of different abilities and increasingly powerful artifacts that create a sense of certain progression, but that strength is built upon the foundation of acquired items and [i]souls[/i], and is not inherent to the characters themselves, which can take away from one’s sense of power. Of course, there is a simple solution to this conundrum. Introducing: the [i]Experience System[/i].

The concept is simple and fairly common - [i]Experience Points[/i], awarded for practically any noteworthy activity in the world of [b]Elteria[/b], from obliterating hordes of monsters to performing masterful mushroom combos, to completing many, many quests and defeating powerful bosses. And upon gathering enough [i]Experience Points[/i], you automatically obtain a new [b]Character Level[/b].

The main draw of these [b]Character Levels[/b] is power, as each level increases the character’s stats, according to the chosen calling, making it easier to tackle some of the more dangerous challenges on the islands of [b]Elteria[/b]. Additionally, some [i]Calling[/i] abilities, as well as some of the more difficult Quests (which also means the rewards for completing them) can only be accessed after obtaining a certain [b]Character Level[/b].

At the moment of implementation, the [b]Character Levels[/b] will be capped at Level 20, with additional levels being introduced into the game alongside the new [b][i]Story Chapters[/i][/b].

As such, prepare to become far more powerful than you were ever before when the [i]Experience System[/i] drops on the [b]Elteria Adventures[/b] alpha servers - and join our [b][url=https://discord.gg/xzvzqY]Discord server[/url][/b] so you can be instantly notified of its release. 

[b]And see you next time![/b]

notes.title: Incoming: Private Zones upgrades
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/8b293fc01ee77422206e502ebbafc6a8791ae902.png[/img]

[b]Greetings from the [b]Elteria Adventures[/b] team![/b]

So, [i]Private Zones[/i]. At the moment, these are a fun side activity that allows the player to utilize the game’s creative tools in order to build… Well, practically anything that can fit in a pretty big area granted to them by the game, out of practically any resource they encounter. Creating your own custom home base is fun - but what if it also made your character a little bit stronger? Well, that notion is the main reason behind the incoming [i]Comfort Level[/i].

[i]Comfort Level[/i] is a system for tracking, well, how comfortable your home base is in terms of having all the necessities and furnishings. The main ways of increasing it are threefold:

[b]-Building crafting stations[/b] - (unique workbenches, furnace, cauldron, etc) - with many different resources gathered during one’s travels across the world of [b]Elteria[/b];

[b]-Installing statues and stellas[/b] - obtained by completing certain important quests and assignments, or battling dangerous, powerful foes;

[b]-Crafting/obtaining trophies [/b] - collected by challenging certain, powerful foes.

As your character raises their [i]Comfort Level[/i] to certain thresholds, they are able to unlock certain bonuses. These bonuses range from stat increases to new passive and active abilities to perhaps even summoning help from some of [b]Elteria’s[/b] prominent, powerful entities and unlocking entirely new quest chains with astonishing rewards - and all of that while your home base bears more and more marks of your amazing, past adventures.

So gather up the resources, hone your tactics and skills against such terrifying bosses as [b]Blue Shark[/b] and [b]Abomination Octopus[/b], and plan out the perfect base to house all of your trophies in - and [b]see you next time![/b]

notes.title: Agelon’s Bugle article: Royal palace makes a buzz!
notes.content:

If you want to discuss the story, head over to our [b][url=https://discord.gg/u2AVU5K]Discord[/url][/b] server!

“It was hard not to notice the air of suspense and uneasiness in [i]Agelon[/i] for the past few days. After all, the [b]royal castle[/b] was put under a lockdown and right before the A[b]wakening Festival[/b], no less! With the only people leaving the castle being the guards on rather silent patrols, and the sudden arrival of several mages, researchers, alchemists and potion masters into the castle, the situation gave birth to quite a few rumors, none of which we have, or will ever disclose due to their sheer speculative nature.

As the [b]Awakening Festival[/b] grew closer, the city was preparing for it with a sense of wariness, since per tradition, due to the lack of a queen, it befell on our young king [i]Veliger[/i] to open the festival with a speech. Luckily, on the morning of the first day of the festival, the lockdown was lifted, and the king was right there on the capital’s main square to uphold said tradition - and it was the moment the good people of [i]Agelon[/i] learned the truth of the situation in the days prior.

For the king was now a bee.

That is correct - due to some undisclosed circumstances, the king was polymorphed into a bee, and neither the passage of time, nor magic, nor medicine relieved him of this unfortunate condition. Luckily, as he enthusiastically buzzed his surprisingly intelligible speech, his loyal subjects came to realize that our fair king’s current circumstances do little in order to impede him in his royal duties. Of course, this does raise the question of the royal succession, but there’s quite enough time for this condition to run its course, or for the king and his royal adviser [i]Marah[/i] to find a cure.

As such, the Awakening Festival had started without a hitch, and the royal kitchen even participated in it with a huge batch of bee-shaped honey lemon caramels and beehive cookies. They were bee-licious!

Full transcript of king [b][i]Veliger’s[/i][/b] speech on page 3”

One day, a bright fallen star descended upon one of the [i]Elterian[/i] islands. For days, noxious clouds of dust, smoke and nauseating fumes raged through the skies surrounding this land, in its heated agony most akin to the fiery depths of abyss.

Yet, soon enough the dust had settled, and the heat died out. Seeing that, the neighbouring Hares were the first to react - and before any other race of [b]Elteria[/b] even managed to send out a scouting party to assess if this island possessed any threat, the Hares have already managed to construct an entire coliseum on this island. Today, as we’re releasing the new, big and shiny 0.15 mega update, you’ll find that the game had indeed changed quite a bit.

Today’s update introduces the [b]Hub[/b] and the [b]Chapters[/b]. The [b]Hub[/b] is located in the castle of [i]Agelon[/i], which serves as the capital city of the human civilization on Elteria. As a newly arrived hero, you’ll help the citizens of [i]Agelon[/i], as well as the people of its many satellite towns. In the first two released story [b]Chapters[/b], you’ll investigate the current happenings of the relatively peaceful town of [i]Faldaren[/i] in Birch Hills, as well as learn about some of the cutest denizens of [b]Elteria[/b] in the mystical and wondrous town of [i]Orzan[/i] located in the [i]Tentacle Grove[/i]. Maybe you’ll even learn some of the deeply rooted secrets of the strange yet beautiful world of [b]Elteria[/b] in this journey of yours.

In order to help you experience this adventure to its fullest, we have also made some changes to the gameplay.

[list]
[*] No more pointless grind to level up your [i]Calling[/i]. Every [i]Calling[/i] has a handful of balanced (or even re-balanced!) abilities that scale with the power of your equipment, and you’re able to change your calling at almost any given time. In one of the future updates, you might find a way to acquire even more [i]Calling[/i] abilities for every [i]Calling[/i] in your arsenal.

In order to ensure the smooth story experience, as well as to prevent any griefing, we have limited the ability to build structures to the players’ own Private Zones - though some free-to-build areas might also appear in some of the future updates.

[*] There’s a paper shortage in the local store. For the time being, the quest info is limited to the quest tracking on the playing screen. It’ll take us some time to implement a fully functional quest log, which will come in one of the future updates.

notes.title: Incoming: Chapters and Hub areas!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/13232863e3a5389a90f82395541a73b76b62b7c7.jpg[/img]

If you want to discuss the news, head over to our [b][url=https://discord.gg/u2AVU5K]Discord[/url][/b] server!

And once again, [b]greetings from Elteria Adventures team![/b]

Today we’re here to discuss the incoming changes to the character progression system and the following quality-of-life improvements related to the world itself.

The current crafting and leveling systems work off a premise of requiring the player to collect crafting ingredients and souls across several different biomes. These requirements are mainly connected to the Tier system, and they possess one glaring problem. Because of how they can cause the player to spend tens of minutes traveling from one edge of the map to the other, they make the world way too big for its own good.

It’s not very exciting to traverse through several layers of several different biomes in search of red gel and frost iron ore nuggets, only to then remember that you also need to collect several types of gems and a liana soul. Which is why we’ve decided to make sure you won’t have to travel too far at any given time. Introducing, [b][b]Chapters[/b][/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/e8c5c2a9dd7fba5d374735e4292b1bb9ea447ddf.jpg[/img][i]Chapters: getting through this giant world one not-that-giant chunk at a time[/i]

[b]Chapters[/b] are, essentially, gameplay and story beats separated from the rest of the world and limited to one or two biomes at a time. Each chapter has all the resources a player would need to complete it, with carefully adjusted strengths of encountered enemies and a difficult (but extremely satisfying) boss fight at the end of the chapter. Defeat the boss, receive the resources you need to prepare yourself for the next chapter, then proceed on your journey.

This way of progression allows us to rework the difficulty system in the game, getting rid of Tiers in favor of chapter-based leveling system. This, of course, also means that there will be some adjustments and changes to the Callings, with the biggest one being that every calling will be available to the player from the very start, and these callings can be easily and freely changed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/5eb4750beea6ea2b026eebbc71c0a5af44fea67c.jpg[/img][i]This is the first Hub area. Yes, it’s a giant castle. And yes, it’s cool.[/i]

And how will you be able to access the [b]Chapters[/b]? Via a Hub area, of course. Hubs are safe places that grant players access to different [b]Chapters[/b] through several special Portals. These Hubs also house players’ Homebases, serve as community centers, and will host community events.

Also, we’re getting rid of the Multitool’s Gather ability - you’ll be able to gather the resources with Digging, jumping, or other mechanics and abilities instead, depending on the type of resource, since that was also not very fun to do.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/819428719c5cd99e499b2bb1390ba0cc565ea075.jpg[/img][i]This portal might be spooky, but it probably leads to the tasty watermelon piglets. Maybe.[/i]

The Hub area, along with the first [b]Chapters[/b], are scheduled to soon arrive to the alpha servers. Be sure not to miss them, and be sure to stay tuned for even more exciting news!

[b]See you soon![/b]

notes.title: Incoming brand new Calling: The Summoner!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/367d4a24a59c49d9bd43ba3fd4097ac81f708f61.jpg[/img]

If you want to discuss the news, head over to our [b][url=https://discord.gg/u2AVU5K]Discord[/url][/b] server!

[b]Once again, greetings from the Elteria Adventures team![/b] 

Today, we’ve brought you something extra special: the juicy details on the new incoming Calling, its mechanics and abilities! Introducing: the Summoner!

So, let’s talk abilities. Just as its name suggests, this calling is all about summoning [b]Elteria’s[/b] [i]flora[/i] - and sometimes even [i]fauna[/i]. The Summoners are all about strategic placement of their abilities. Each summon lasts for about seven seconds, so it is crucial to know when, where and how to use each ability.

[h1]Basic Ability:[/h1]
The Summoner’s basic ability is to summon a [b][i]Toxic Mushroom[/i][/b]. These Mushrooms explode with toxic spores on contact with the enemy, inflicting damage over time, and the Summoner can normally have only three of these Mushrooms active at a time.

However, if an enemy dies while under the effect of these spores, they grow into yet another [b][i]Toxic Mushroom[/i][/b] that doesn’t count towards the Summoner’s limit.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/c1063ce88d49f20fb0a611b89bc3d85bf6aa3832.jpg[/img][i]Don’t eat those mushrooms. Make your enemies eat them instead.[/i]

[h1]Other summons:[/h1]
[i][b]Jumper Sunflower[/b][/i] and [i][b]Bumper Mushroom[/b][/i]: summon a [i]Sunflower[/i] that sends anyone who steps on it high into the air, and a [i]Mushroom[/i] that flings anyone who touches it across the air. Use these abilities for utility, or to control your enemy’s movement!

[u][b]Slime[/b][/u]: depending on this ability’s level, summon a [i]Green Slime[/i], a [i]Blue Slime[/i], or a [i]Red Slime[/i]. Each of these critters would gladly fight for you, dealing damage to the enemies, as well as knocking them back!

[u][b]Tentacle[/b][/u]: summon a Tentacle that attacks the nearest enemy up to 3 times, and then disappears.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/5728e0fba966fa8d88b3cb016194c058fa55c8e0.jpg[/img]
[i]The power of bounciness can be used for the greater good. Or for evil, if you’re into that.[/i]

[h1]Tentacle Festival:[/h1]
Summoner’s final ability is, perhaps, the most fearsome one. This ability sacrifices all of the active summons, including the bonus [i][b]Toxic Mushrooms[/b][/i], and replaces each summon with a [i]Tentacle[/i]. Each of these [i]Tentacles[/i] attacks its nearest enemy for up to 3 times, and then disappears.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/3776dff11f0c051fde0fe0785e6d479148b4c401.png[/img]
[i]Just a few seconds of a setup - and your enemy will become the punchline[/i]

Summoner’s abilities are synergetic and, given enough precision, coordination and awareness, can do wonders on the battlefield, making short work of practically any enemy, and even turning Summoner into a secondary tank.

Prepare to reach the utmost potential of the Summoner’s awesome arsenal of abilities, and stay tuned for even more news, 

[b]See you soon![/b]
